Subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC / air-gap requirements

Thanks for your time today — want to capture the key takeaways and next steps so we have alignment before the technical deep dive. Summary below.

Attendees: Alex Wu (AcmeHealth), Priya Sen (AcmeHealth), Procurement, Marissa Cole (Redwood), Rishi Malhotra (Redwood)

Pain points / drivers:
- PHI + regulated PII: AcmeHealth requires strict data residency controls and auditability for all inference requests.
- Network constraints: pilot must run in a private VPC or fully air-gapped on-prem environment. No outbound internet for inference nodes; only approved private peering and VPN tunnels.
- Key management: customer-managed KMS/HSM is a hard requirement.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + HITRUST is expected; need evidence for logging/audit trail and retention policies.
- Latency/cost: objective is to keep 95th percentile token latency under 200ms for the primary route while maintaining predictable unit costs.

What Redwood can offer (high level):
- Private deployment options: VPC-hosted private control plane and an on-prem / air-gap package for regulated workloads.
- Customer-managed KMS/HSM integration and audit log export.
- Network architecture patterns: VPC peering, private endpoints, or fully air-gapped deployment with rsync-based model sync.

Action items / next steps:
1) Redwood to share the initial network checklist and an architecture diagram for both VPC and air-gap flows (attached).
2) Technical deep-dive with Acme infra/security + our infra lead (Rishi) — propose week of Oct 12. Please share availability.
3) Procurement: we will surface a preliminary SOW and ballpark pricing for Private + air-gap options within 5 business days of the technical deep-dive.
4) Acme to confirm: preferred pilot scope (number of models, throughput targets) and the internal security contact for evidence collection.

Attachments: Redwood_Private_VPC_Requirements.pdf (network & security checklist), Network_Prelim_Checklist.xlsx (questions for network team)

If I missed anything or you'd like this formatted as a short MDR / mutual action plan, tell me and I can publish it to the shared drive.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC / air-gap requirements

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications: 

- For the air-gap option, can Redwood confirm the mechanism for model updates (push vs. pull) and whether the sync can be done over an approved offline transfer process? We need to document the process for our auditors.
- KMS/HSM: can we use our on-prem HSM (customer-managed) or is Redwood's KMS required? We prefer customer-managed keys.
- TLS termination: will TLS terminate inside our VPC or at Redwood's control plane? If termination is outside our network that will be a blocker.

Also — timeline question. We're aiming to kick off a pilot in Q1 2027. Will Redwood be able to commit to a pilot delivery window if we proceed with the air-gap path (assuming contract and infra approvals)? Ballpark pricing now would help speed procurement.

I'll loop in our security lead after we get the checklist.

Thanks Alex — good questions. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Model update mechanism: both push and pull patterns are supported. For fully air-gapped installs we use an offline bundle process (signed model packages + checksum) that your infra team can pull from a secure media drop. We'll include the detailed steps in the checklist we just attached.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed HSM/KMS integrations. The on-prem HSM option is supported; Rishi will walk through the setup details on the technical call.
- TLS termination: we can terminate TLS inside your VPC or on-prem environment. Redwood will not require plaintext egress; we can present a diagram showing options during the deep-dive.

Pilot timeline and pricing:
- Pilot: typical lead time for Private VPC is 6-8 weeks from contract signature; air-gapped on-prem pilots have additional validation and can be 10-12 weeks depending on hardware readiness.
- Ballpark: we'll provide a preliminary cost range in the SOW post-deep-dive — Rishi and I will include a baseline for instance sizing and operational runbook.

Availability for technical deep-dive (Rishi to lead):
- Tue Oct 13: 11:00-12:30 PT
- Wed Oct 14: 09:00-10:00 PT or 15:00-16:00 PT
Please confirm which slot works for your team and we'll send a calendar invite with an agenda (networking checklist, KMS/HSM integration, logging/audit exports, pilot sizing).
